workflow.title: Ticket auto-replies (invoice copy or support redirect)
workflow.goal: For each open ticket, send one auto-reply signed Nimbus Support. Invoice-copy requests get the Billing > Invoices instruction. All other open tickets get a reply pointing to support@nimbusdesk.app.

assumptions: Open tickets are those with status 'open'.
An invoice-copy request is a ticket whose subject or body mentions 'invoice'; every other ticket is 'everything else'.
'Everything else goes to support@nimbusdesk.app' means the auto-reply tells the customer to contact that address.
Each outbound reply is approved by a person before it is sent.
risks: Keyword matching on 'invoice' may catch tickets that do not ask for a copy of an invoice.
Each reply is an outbound email; a person must approve every send.
successCriteria: Every open ticket receives exactly one auto-reply at its 'from' address.
Invoice-copy replies point to Billing > Invoices; all other replies point to support@nimbusdesk.app.
Every reply is signed Nimbus Support.
The outbox audit confirms recipients and message bodies.

nodes.description: Label each open ticket with the reply text: invoice-copy requests get the billing instruction, all others get the support redirect.

set.replyBody:
Hello,

Thanks for contacting us. You can find a copy of your invoice in your account under Billing > Invoices.

Nimbus Support

otherwise.replyBody:
Hello,

Thanks for contacting us. For this request, please email support@nimbusdesk.app and our team will help you.

Nimbus Support
